visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a person's hands holding a blue and white retail package for a HIDISC Type-C rechargeable AA battery. The background is a bright, out-of-focus garden with green foliage and natural sunlight filtering through the leaves. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor retail environment, showing the battery pack hanging on a display hook alongside other mobile accessories like white power banks. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail store like Daiso. (3) The camera returns to a hand-held perspective where the individual peels back the plastic blister packaging to extract the single blue battery. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space, possibly near a window, with a wooden table surface visible. (4) A tight macro shot focuses on the top end of the battery, revealing a built-in USB Type-C charging port next to the positive terminal. The battery's blue metallic texture and printed specifications are clearly visible. (5) A white Type-C charging cable is plugged into the battery's port. A small LED ring at the top of the battery begins to flash with a bright blue light, indicating the charging process. (6) The battery is shown again with a solid, non-flashing blue light, signifying a full charge. The cable is then pulled out by hand. (7) The person places the battery into the open battery compartment of a black Microsoft wireless mouse sitting on a cluttered desk. (8) The plastic battery cover of the mouse is snapped shut. Large pink and blue variety-show style text appears on the screen to summarize the item's uses. (9) The final frame shows the retail display again with text encouraging viewers to buy the product for environmental benefits.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Discovery -> Demonstration -> Utility -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and demonstrate a novel tech gadget found at Daiso: a AA battery that can be charged directly via a Type-C cable. By showing the unboxing, the physical charging port, and the battery in actual use with a mouse, it highlights the convenience and environmental benefits of the product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video appears to be a personal discovery vlog rather than a paid advertisement, though it features specific brands prominently.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The high use of colorful, large-scale text overlays suggests this is content optimized for social media platforms like TikTok or Instagram Reels. The rhythmic synchronization between the visual cuts and the upbeat BGM enhances viewer engagement.
